card.name: Start of names split after capitalized first piece
card.fires_on: A capitalized common word like By, During, With or Up that is really the first piece of a proper name or brand, such as Byers, Bywater, Byrd, BYETTA, BYLVAY. Also a Chinese character starting a name.

modes.label: By- at start of names
modes.description: The word By or BY begins a surname, place name or brand name that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: Battle of<< By>>water The Battle of Bywater was

modes.label: Other common word starting a surname
modes.description: A word like During, With or Up that opens a surname in a reference list or author list.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: BY begins an uppercase drug brand name in label text.
modes.example: After initiation of<< BY>>ETTA, observe patients carefully for signs

card.writes: It seems to push toward word endings and joiners that continue a name, such as 'ness' and 'serter'.
card.plain: It fires on a short opening piece of a name that looks like an ordinary word, such as By in Byers or BYETTA.
